## Installation

You can install the development version of MPOInt from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("zoe-schaefer/MPOInt")
```

## Articles

View the two cases explored in the publication in the
[Articles](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/articles/) section.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`MCF7_histones`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/MCF7_histones.md)
  : MCF-7 histone proteome dataset.
- [`MCF7_phospho`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/MCF7_phospho.md)
  : MCF-7 phosphoproteome dataset.
- [`MCF7_total`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/MCF7_total.md)
  : MCF-7 total proteome dataset.
- [`THP1_histones`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/THP1_histones.md)
  : THP-1 histone proteome dataset.
- [`THP1_phospho`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/THP1_phospho.md)
  : THP-1 phosphoproteome dataset.
- [`THP1_total`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/THP1_total.md)
  : THP-1 total proteome dataset.
- [`clean_names()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/clean_names.md)
  : Clean up names from EpiProfile.
- [`genes`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/genes.md) :
  EpiFactors gene set.
- [`histone_epi()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/histone_epi.md)
  : Process individual data for histone proteome.
- [`histone_summary()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/histone_summary.md)
  : Process summary data for histone proteome.
- [`multi_net()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/multi_net.md)
  : Generate a multi-level proteome network from total proteome,
  phosphoproteome, and epiproteome data.
- [`volcano_epi()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/volcano_epi.md)
  : Generate a volcano plot for epiproteome data.
- [`volcano_groups()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/volcano_groups.md)
  : Generate a volcano plot with groups of interest.
- [`volcanoplot()`](https://zoe-schaefer.github.io/MPOInt/reference/volcanoplot.md)
  : Generate a volcano plot.
